pattern: Do not state an unverified claim as a fact.
criterion: Do not state an unverified claim as a fact.

lesson.title: Verify Shopping Cart Contents Before Stating Cart Items
lesson.when: A customer asks to confirm or check items in their cart, but source evidence does not establish the contents of their cart
lesson.do: Search and verify the actual cart contents using source tools before claiming specific items are in the cart
lesson.otherwise: State uncertainty regarding the current cart contents instead of asserting specific products are present
triggers: xác nhận sản phẩm trong giỏ
